parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
- MESSAGE_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: UNSPECIFIED — never persisted.
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_PENDING: PENDING — send in progress. Reserved for future async-send flow;
the sync flow does NOT write PENDING (currently unused).
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_SENT: SENT — the vendor synchronously accepted the send request.
For SMS: vendor API returned OK; does NOT mean handset received
         (async delivery is not tracked yet).
For email: SMTP server accepted the message.
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_FAILED: FAILED — the vendor rejected the request, network/transport failed,
or context was cancelled. error_message carries the last error.

ListEmailsByCursor returns a cursor-paginated list of email records.
Stable under concurrent writes: ordering is (sort_field, id) with id as
tiebreaker, so inserts mid-scan do not cause skips or duplicates.
Skips COUNT(*) by default; set include_total=true when totals are needed
(the first page can usually return total == len(records) without a count).
Errors: ErrPersistenceDisabled (503) when email persistence is off;
ErrBadRequest on malformed page_token.

post.summary:
SendEmail sends an email via the configured vendor/account, or the default
fallback chain when both vendor + account are unset.
post.description:
Idempotency (when idempotency_key is set): Redis dedupes per
(sender_id, idempotency_key).
  - First request: sends + caches the success response.
  - Concurrent second request: returns ErrIdempotencyConflict (409) while
    the first is in flight.
  - Sequential replay after success: returns the cached response without
    re-sending.
  - Failure: reservation released — caller can retry the same key.

Required fields: to, subject, body (or html_body), scene, sender_id.
vendor + account must be set together or both empty.
Returns: record ID + MessageStatus (SENT on success).
Errors: ErrBadRequest on validation; ErrMessageSendFailed on vendor
rejection / transport failure (NOT cached — safe to retry the same key).

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: SendEmailRequest is the request to send an email.

post.summary:
SendSMS sends an SMS via the configured vendor/account, or routes by phone
country code when both are unset.
post.description:
Path selection by region_code:
  - "CN" (domestic): template-based only. template_id + sign_name +
    template_params required; content is ignored.
  - other (international): caller picks ONE of template_id (template-based
    vendor: Byteplus, Tencent intl) OR content (raw-content vendor: Aliyun
    intl, Twilio-style). Setting both is a validation error.

Idempotency: same contract as SendEmail.
Required fields: region_code (ISO alpha-2), phone (local, no "+"), scene,
sender_id. sign_name required for CN + some intl paths.
Returns: record ID + MessageStatus (SENT on success).
Errors: ErrBadRequest on validation (incl. invalid phone / region); see
SendSMSRequest.phone_no_plus for the "+" rule.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: SendSMSRequest is the request to send an SMS.

v1EmailAddress.description:
EmailAddress is one recipient or sender. email is required; display_name
is optional and rendered as the RFC 5322 mailbox "Name" <email> form when
set. The service persists only the bare email (for query filtering);
display_name is not stored.

filename.description: filename is the MIME filename. Required.

url.description:
url is the HTTP or HTTPS URL of the attachment content. Service fetches
the bytes at send time. Mutually exclusive with content — exactly one of
the two must be set. Service rejects non-http(s) schemes (file://, ftp://,
gopher://, etc.) to mitigate SSRF; the HTTP client does not follow
redirects.

content.description:
content is the raw attachment bytes supplied inline. Mutually exclusive
with url — exactly one of the two must be set. Bounded by
attachment.max_inline_bytes (single attachment) and
attachment.max_total_inline_bytes (sum across the request). Attachments
exceeding these limits must use url instead.

inline.description:
inline selects rendering: true = CID-embedded (display inline in the
body where the caller referenced the CID); false = regular attachment
shown in the client's attachment list. When inline=true with a non-image
MIME type, the attachment silently falls back to regular.

mimeType.description: mime_type is optional. Empty = let MIME detection infer from filename.

sizeBytes.description:
size_bytes is optional. When non-zero, pre-validated against
max_bytes (url path: before fetch; content path: against len(content)).
Zero = no pre-check; the hard cap is still enforced after fetch / for
content length.

v1EmailAttachment.description:
EmailAttachment describes one attachment on an email. Source of bytes is
either url (caller-managed object storage) or content (inline bytes for
small attachments). The same message type appears on SendEmailRequest
(input) and EmailRecord (query).

senderId.description:
SenderID identifies the calling business service (e.g. "user-service",
"pay-service"). NOT the end-user/admin id — the caller must record that
in its own audit trail.

attachments.description:
attachments lists metadata for each attachment recorded at send time.
Empty when no attachments were sent or persistence is disabled.

v1EmailRecord.description: EmailRecord is the stored record of a sent email.

v1EmailScene.description:
EmailScene represents the business purpose of an email. Required on every
send. Used for audit, filtering, and stats grouping — NOT for routing
(vendor selection is independent of scene).

 - EMAIL_SCENE_LOGIN_CODE: One-time login verification code.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_FORGOT_PASSWORD: Password reset link / code.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_REGISTER: Registration verification code.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_CHANGE_PASSWORD: Confirmation of password change.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_BIND_ACCOUNT: Bind a new email/identity to an account.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_NOTIFICATION: Generic transactional notification.
 - EMAIL_SCENE_VERIFY_EMAIL: Verify ownership of an email address.

v1EmailVendor.description:
EmailVendor represents the email service brand. Each vendor offers SMTP
access today; an API path may be added per-vendor in the future. Vendor
is an audit label and (vendor, account) selection key — the underlying
transport is always SMTP. Vendors are configured in config.yaml; selecting
one with an unconfigured account returns ErrBadRequest.

 - EMAIL_VENDOR_ALIYUN: Aliyun DirectMail.
 - EMAIL_VENDOR_TENCENT: Tencent SES.
 - EMAIL_VENDOR_NETEASE: NetEase EasyMail.

v1EmailVendorStats.description: EmailVendorStats holds per-vendor statistics for email messages.

total.description:
total is 0 when include_total = false. Otherwise reflects the count
matching the filter (ignoring cursor position).

nextPageToken.description: next_page_token is empty when there is no next page.

v1ListEmailsResponse.description: ListEmailsResponse contains a page of email records plus pagination metadata.

v1ListSMSResponse.description: ListSMSResponse contains a page of SMS records plus pagination metadata.

v1MessageStatus.description:
MessageStatus represents the delivery status of a message.

 - MESSAGE_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: UNSPECIFIED — never persisted.
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_PENDING: PENDING — send in progress. Reserved for future async-send flow;
the sync flow does NOT write PENDING (currently unused).
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_SENT: SENT — the vendor synchronously accepted the send request.
For SMS: vendor API returned OK; does NOT mean handset received
         (async delivery is not tracked yet).
For email: SMTP server accepted the message.
 - MESSAGE_STATUS_FAILED: FAILED — the vendor rejected the request, network/transport failed,
or context was cancelled. error_message carries the last error.

v1Pong.description:
MessageService handles sending, recording, and querying messages.

Channel split: emails and SMSs have parallel RPC families — Send, Get,
List (offset), ListByCursor, and Stats — plus three cross-channel helpers
(ListSMSRegions / ListSMSSenders / ListEmailSenders) for UI filter dropdowns.

Persistence: when persistence.{email,sms}.enabled = false, query RPCs return
ErrPersistenceDisabled (503) — send RPCs still work (records skipped).

Idempotency: orthogonal to persistence. When idempotency_key is set, Redis
dedupes per (sender_id, key); see SendEmail/SendSMS for the exact contract.
Pong is the health-check response — only public, non-sensitive info
(service name, version, git/build info, timestamps). Never include internal
addresses, IPs, env vars, secrets, or dependency topology here.

senderId.description: SenderID identifies the calling business service. See SendSMSRequest.sender_id.

v1SMSRecord.description: SMSRecord is the stored record of a sent SMS.

vendor.description:
Vendor + Account optionally select a specific configured account.
Both must be set together; if both zero/empty, sender uses default fallback.

templateId.description: Template is optional: vendors that do not support templating ignore it.

scene.description: Scene is the business purpose of this email (required).

senderId.description:
SenderID identifies the calling business service (e.g. "user-service",
"pay-service"). Required. NOT the end-user/admin id — the caller must
record that in its own audit trail.

idempotencyKey.description:
IdempotencyKey is optional. When set, a second request with the same
(sender_id, idempotency_key) returns the existing record without
re-sending. Use a UUID per logical send intent. Max length 64.

from.description:
From optionally overrides the account's configured From address.
Empty falls back to the account default. The SMTP server is the
ultimate arbiter of which From addresses are accepted (verified
sender lists, etc.); the service does not pre-constrain.

attachments.description:
attachments is optional. LINK attachments augment html_body; MIME
attachments are downloaded and added as real MIME parts. Mixed lists
are allowed — each attachment carries its own kind.

v1SendEmailRequest.description: SendEmailRequest is the request to send an email.

v1SendResponse.description: SendResponse is the response from SendEmail and SendSMS.

regionCode.description:
region_code is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code used to parse phone
(e.g. "CN", "US", "HK"). Required. Acts as defaultRegion for
phonenumber parsing — NOT a dialing code like "86".

phone.description:
phone is the local phone number WITHOUT the international prefix
(e.g. "13800138000", "5551234567"). Must NOT start with "+".

content.description:
content is the raw SMS body for vendors that accept raw text (typically
the international path). Substitution of placeholders (e.g. "{code}") is
the caller's responsibility — message-service forwards the string as-is.

vendor.description:
Vendor + Account optionally select a specific configured account.
Both must be set together; if both zero/empty, sender routes by phone country.

scene.description: Scene is the business purpose of this SMS (required).

senderId.description:
SenderID identifies the calling business service (e.g. "user-service",
"pay-service"). Required. NOT the end-user/admin id — the caller must
record that in its own audit trail.

signName.description:
SignName carries the per-message signature/sender ID semantics:
  - For domestic SMS (region_code == "CN"): the SMS signature that must
    match the pre-registered sign in the vendor console (e.g. "阿里云",
    "字节跳动"). Domestic vendors reject sends without it.
  - For international SMS (other region_code): treated as the sender ID
    / "From" field. Some regions require pre-registered alphabetic
    sender IDs; vendors apply region-specific rules.
Required for paths whose vendor enforces a signature (all current
domestic vendors do).

v1SendSMSRequest.description: SendSMSRequest is the request to send an SMS.

v1SmsScene.description:
SmsScene represents the business purpose of an SMS. Required on every send.
Mirrors EmailScene; VERIFY_PHONE is the SMS counterpart of VERIFY_EMAIL
(cross-channel pairs like VERIFY_EMAIL+SMS are rejected by SendSMS).

 - SMS_SCENE_LOGIN_CODE: One-time login verification code.
 - SMS_SCENE_FORGOT_PASSWORD: Password reset code.
 - SMS_SCENE_REGISTER: Registration verification code.
 - SMS_SCENE_CHANGE_PASSWORD: Confirmation of password change.
 - SMS_SCENE_BIND_ACCOUNT: Bind a new phone to an account.
 - SMS_SCENE_VERIFY_PHONE: Verify ownership of a phone number.

v1SmsVendor.description:
SmsVendor represents the SMS service brand. Path capabilities differ:
  - Domestic (CN) vendors: template-based only; raw content rejected.
  - International vendors split into:
      * raw-content (ALIYUN, VOLCENGINE intl, ...): caller supplies Content.
      * template-based (TENCENT intl, BYTEPLUS): caller supplies TemplateID + Params.
The service picks a path automatically from the destination region_code,
unless the request explicitly sets vendor + account.

 - SMS_VENDOR_ALIYUN: Aliyun (domestic + intl SendMessageToGlobe).
 - SMS_VENDOR_TENCENT: Tencent Cloud SMS (domestic + intl via SdkAppid).
 - SMS_VENDOR_VOLCENGINE: ByteDance Volcengine SMS.
 - SMS_VENDOR_BYTEPLUS: Byteplus (intl-only, template-based).
 - SMS_VENDOR_HUAWEI: Huawei Cloud SMS.

v1SmsVendorStats.description: SmsVendorStats holds per-vendor statistics for SMS messages.

v1SortDirection.description:
SortDirection selects ascending or descending order. UNSPECIFIED must be
treated as DESC by the service layer (preserves current behavior).

v1SortField.description:
SortField selects the column used to order List responses.
Only CREATED_AT is currently defined; future versions may add more.
